title: Prevent Google API keys from being committed in reference sources
acceptance: Dependency-free source scan fails on Google API key candidates and never prints secret values.
CI runs scanner and regression tests for pushes and pull requests.
Regression verifies detection, clean files and no leaked values in diagnostics.
notes: Implement only the listed new files; preserve source provenance and do not modify package configuration.
Tests must run without landmark fixtures so performance snapshots remain valid.
No heavy-validation resources needed for small standalone scanner tests.

Accepted by security-20261012-root: reviewed source diff and handoff; focused tests and current source scan passed. GitHub alerts 1 and 2 resolved with accurate third-party disposition; no key revocation claimed.
